module_summary: Tree pseudo-LRU tracker: a registered binary tree of direction bits is updated on one-hot use hits and decoded combinationally into a one-hot replacement candidate.

anchors.name: plru_tree_q
anchors.why: Registered PLRU tree node bits, cleared by clr_i, decoded into plru_o

anchors.name: used_i
anchors.why: One-hot used-entry input that sets tree nodes along its path

anchors.name: plru_o
anchors.why: One-hot least-recently-used entry from tree traversal

anchors.name: plru_replacement.new_index
anchors.why: Per-level node value written into plru_tree_d on a use hit

anchors.name: plru_replacement.idx_base
anchors.why: Level base index locating tree node to update

groups.name: Tree update
groups.description: Computes next tree bits from used entry

groups.name: Replacement decode
groups.description: Traverses tree to one-hot LRU output
